selection_tests: 2 arms x 2 alternatives versus first5 x 3 outcomes = 12; Bonferroni alpha=.05/12
confirmation_tests: 2 arms x winner versus first5 x 3 outcomes = 6; Bonferroni alpha=.05/6
subgroups: 20-person paired statistics are descriptive subgroup diagnostics, not extra confirmatory tests. All adoption decisions use the overall preregistered family.
winner: KDA selection-block success count descending, collision count ascending, timeout count ascending; exact tie prefers first5, then nearest5, then ttc5. GRU does not select the winner.
if_first5_wins: No alternative selected; report selection negative and do not duplicate first5 confirmation as a method test.
adoption_gate: KDA fresh confirmation SR improvement passes six-test Bonferroni, and pooled CR and TO do not increase. Report all per-cell safety regressions; no tuning after confirmation.
selection_anchor: Select once at real current state; current frame and all80 successor candidates use exactly the same selected actor indices. Preserve original list order within selected set; inherited token TTC sort unchanged. For N<=5 keep original order exactly.
ttc: Existing contracts formula, with inherited float32 robot round trip; no new risk definition
parity: windows and values bitwise; rewards/clearance inherited scalar-vector float64 difference <=2e-15, explicitly not claimed bitwise; argmax identical; 5-person all three rules bitwise identical

devices.kda: RTX4090 existing torch2.9.1 environment after foreign pipeline completes

cross_device: Within-arm paired comparisons only; no cross-arm absolute SR subtraction without equivalence validation
foreign_completion: /root/bayes-fix-20261008/complete.json plus original controller PID identity ended plus no active GPU jobs; never kill foreign jobs
no_effect_claim: Not significant does not prove zero. Report confidence intervals in matching cohorts; no fixed 1.5pp detection floor or automatic rejection of old20-person17pp effect.
